tools.name: watch_url
tools.description:
Start watching a public web page for changes when you cannot stay running yourself. Use when a task needs to know whether a page changed since you last looked, and you will not be alive to check: a price, a status page, a job listing, a policy, a schedule, a document.

Give it a URL. It takes a firs

tools.name: check_changes
tools.description: Ask whether a watched page changed since you last checked, using the token from watch_url. Returns the monitor status, checks remaining, changed_since_last_poll, and the latest signed change record with a line diff excerpt. Safe to call from any later run; calling it marks the changes as seen.

tools.name: unwatch_url
tools.description: Stop a monitor by token. Remaining checks are forfeited.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: watch_url · Private data: watch_url, check_changes, unwatch_url · Public sink: watch_url · Destructive: watch_url, check_changes.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: watch_url · Private data: watch_url, check_changes, unwatch_url · Public sink: watch_url · Destructive: watch_url, check_changes

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
